period.note_en: The Quran gives no date or era for the creation of Adam or for his time in the garden or on the earth.

region.note_en: The Quran does not say where the garden was, nor which part of the earth Adam and his wife went down to.

community.text_en: The Quran later addresses humankind as the children of Adam, and tells Adam and his wife that on the earth some of them would be enemies of others.

lifespan.note_en: The Quran gives no age for Adam and no length for his stay in the garden or on the earth.

daily_activities.text_en: In the garden God told Adam and his wife to live there and to take of it freely, wherever they wished, with one tree they were not to approach.

occupation.note_en: The Quran names no trade or work for Adam. It speaks of a successor placed on the earth and of names taught to him, which is not stated as an occupation.

foods_beverages.text_en: In the garden Adam and his wife were told to take of it freely, and Adam was told he would not go hungry or be thirsty there; one tree was forbidden to them.

farming_livestock.note_en: The Quran does not describe any farming or herding by Adam.

clothing_care.text_en: In the garden Adam was told he would not be without clothing. After the slip, he and his wife began to cover themselves with leaves of the garden.

housing.text_en: God told Adam to dwell in the garden with his wife. After the descent, the earth was to be a place to live and provision for a time.

transport.note_en: The Quran does not mention any means of travel for Adam. It speaks of a descent to the earth without describing how it happened.

family_community.text_en: Adam had a wife, and God warned Adam that the one who refused to prostrate was an enemy to him and to his wife.

customs_leisure.note_en: The Quran does not describe customs or leisure in the life of Adam.

education.text_en: God taught Adam the names, all of them, and when God told him to inform the angels of the names, he did so.

health_treatment.note_en: The Quran does not mention illness or treatment in the account of Adam.

climate.text_en: The Quran describes the garden as a place where Adam would not suffer from the sun's heat. It gives no description of the climate of the earth he came down to.

worship.text_en: After the slip, Adam and his wife said they had wronged themselves and asked for forgiveness and mercy; Adam received words from his Lord and God accepted his repentance.

challenges.text_en: Satan whispered to Adam and his wife and led them down by deception; they tasted of the tree they had been told to avoid, and God called them back to His warning.

differences_modern.text_en: Educational interpretation (not scripture): the Quran describes Adam's origin in different words in different places (dust, clay, dry clay of moulded mud), and a reader should keep each wording as given rather than merge them or add detail from other sources.

lessons.text_en: Educational interpretation (not scripture): these passages place a warning before the mistake and repentance, acceptance and guidance after it, so that returning to God is presented as open after a slip.
